Short title

The Indian Tariff (Amendment) Act, 1940
The Indian Tariff (Amendment) Act, 1940
Received the assent of the
Governor General on the 10th April 1940, and is published in the " Gazette
of India ", Part IV, dated the 13th April 1940.
Act No. XXI of
1940.
An Act further to amend the Indian Tariff Act, 1934.
1. Short title.---This Act
may be called the Indian Tariff' (Amend. merit) Act, 1940.
Notes
Object.-" In a view
of the possible danger of interruption to, or delays in, communication by sea,
the War Supply Board has decided to purchase a reserve of 7,500 tons of Wattle
Bark at an estimated cost of ten lakhs of rupees, with a view to ensuring
supplies for the important tanning industry. In order to safeguard Government
against possible losses on the liquidation of this reserve it is proposed to
impose, as a temporary measure, a revenue duty of 3% ad valorem on imports of
Barks for tanning. This rate will it is considered impose no appreciable burden
on the tanning industry. The Bill makes the necessary amendment for this
purpose in the Indian Tariff Act 1934 " (Vide Statement of Objects and
Reasons, printed at page 178 of Part V of the Gazette of India, 1940)

Amendment of First Schedule Act XXXII of 1934

The Indian Tariff (Amendment) Act, 1940
The Indian Tariff (Amendment) Act, 1940
Received the assent of the
Governor General on the 10th April 1940, and is published in the " Gazette
of India ", Part IV, dated the 13th April 1940.
Act No. XXI of
1940.
An Act further to amend the Indian Tariff Act, 1934.
2. Amendment of First Schedule
Act XXXII of 1934.--In the First Schedule to the Indian Tariff Act, 1934,
in Item No. 13 (1), in the third column the word " Revenue " shall be
inserted, and in the fourth column for the word " Free " the figure and
words " 3 percent. ad valorem " shall be substituted.
